description: This file defines the class AOR_Condition, which extends the Basic class. It appears to be part of a module related to conditions within the SuiteCRM/AOR framework. The class includes properties defining the condition's schema and a method for saving condition lines, involving complex handling of POST data and interaction with other modules like AOW_WorkFlow.

classes.name: AOR_Condition
classes.description: Represents a condition within the AOR module, handling schema properties and the saving of condition lines in the context of report configurations.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Processes and saves lines of conditions based on POST data, handling deletions, new entries, and encoding of multi-value fields.
